meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 当你要审计设计时，Claude 会按迪特·拉姆斯的十条好设计原则逐项打分并引用证据，判定该设计应新建、细化还是重做，最后生成一个可直接复制的 /make-plan 计划提示词。
howto.when: 当你说“审计这个设计”“设计评审”“检查这个 UI 是否符合 Rams”等，或要求一个能导向计划的批评时触发。不用于常规代码评审、纯文案修改或尚无设计物时的头脑风暴。

say.text: 用 Rams 十原则审计这个设计。
帮我检查这个 UI，再给个细化计划。
say.note: 先审计，再输出 /make-plan 提示。

say.text: 这个页面需要重做吗？给个设计方案。
say.note: 审计后给出 redesign 或 refine 的计划。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a design audit, Claude evaluates the design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each with evidence, decides whether to create, refine, or redesign, and outputs a /make-plan prompt ready to copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'audit this design', 'design review', 'check this UI against Rams', or request a critique that leads to a plan. Not for routine code reviews, pure copy edits, or ideation with no artifact yet.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' principles.
Check this UI and give me a refine plan.
Should this page be redesigned? Provide a plan.
say_en.note: Yields a redesign or refine plan.
